name: callsign
description: Unique per-session agent names + iMessage routing for Claude Code and Hermes. Every session picks its own callsign at start so you can address specific parallel sessions by name from your phone.
author: heyfinal

name: chronicle
description: Cold-storage warehouse + searchable recall for Claude Code session transcripts. Sweeps old ~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl into an SMB/SSD vault, indexes via SQLite FTS5, and lets you search and rehydrate any past session for /resume. First-class AI-agent tool with MCP server.
author: heyfinal
